title: Agreement outside three intervals
statement: For natural numbers $a,n,b,m,c,k$ and integer-valued sequences $\mu,\mu'$, say that they agree at every index that lies outside all three intervals specified by $a,n$, $b,m$, and $c,k$.
caveat: The formal snippet does not define Outside, so the intervals and their boundary conventions cannot be determined from the supplied ground truth.
